verdict.rationale: The evidence documents only one-off literature tasks submitted through the client: create_task, run_tasks_until_done, and batch submission with results queried later. Nothing shows a recurring schedule, saved standing searches, or alerts that surface newly published sources. Deferred retrieval of a one-off task is not a standing search, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As a researcher, I can set up standing searches or alerts that surface new relevant sources as they appear
